overview: This Senate resolution names the minority party's members of Senate committees for the 119th Congress (2025 to 2026), including the ranking member, the top minority-party senator, on each committee. It covers about 20 committees, such as Appropriations, Armed Services, Finance, Foreign Relations, Judiciary, Intelligence, and Veterans' Affairs. Committees are where most bills are first reviewed and changed, so these assignments decide who represents the minority party on each issue. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 7, 2025.
for: Supporters say setting committee rosters promptly lets the Senate start holding hearings and reviewing bills at the start of the new Congress.
against: Critics say the resolution is routine organizational business that does not change any law or policy.
